Earn Combat XP to unlock nodes that enhance your vehicle's characteristics. The final characteristics may end up either higher or lower than the values indicated due to additional additive and multiplicative modifiers applied after node bonuses.
Available exclusively for Tier XI vehicles, Upgrades allow you to enhance your vehicles' characteristics even further.

After researching all nodes, you will gain access to Elite Rewards, which you can claim upon reaching certain Elite Levels. The rewards include a unique volumetric style, Stat Tracker, and gun sleeve!
